thread:
Nora: posted a new pattern for first-run: a 'bento card' in the center of the workspace that surfaces 3 quick actions (Create API Key, Try Sample Project, Import Model). want quick UX + a11y + eng POV.
Ben: love the density. feels like fewer clicks than a full modal. worried about discoverability vs the existing onboarding strip. maybe add a small pulse on first session only.
Kavi: eng notes: bento is mostly static HTML + event hooks. need localStorage flag to hide after dismiss, plus server opt-out per org. keyboard handling: arrow nav between cards, Enter triggers primary CTA. estimate ~1 day.
Iris: a11y checklist: each card needs role=button, aria-label with action + brief desc, focusable order, and an aria-live polite region when a step completes. ensure text-size >=14px and contrast >=4.5:1 for primary text.
Nora: copy variants proposed:
- Primary: "Try a sample project"
- Secondary: "Add credentials"
- Tertiary: "Import your model"
Also microcopy under title: "Get set up in under 5 minutes" (muted).
Ben: analytics: onboarding_bento_shown, bento_action_click (props: action_id, org_id, variant), bento_dismissed. Track time-to-first-request. Add cohort for new-org vs existing-org.
Kavi: implementation caveat: on small screens cards should stack vertically and have larger touch targets. also include prefers-reduced-motion for pulse.
Iris: a11y nit: if we auto-focus the bento, screenreader will jump context. instead, add "Skip tour" in page nav and only focus bento on explicit keyboard entry.
Nora: product decision leaning toward bento as default for first-touch, keep strip as fallback for returning users. AB test: variant A=bento, B=strip. metrics: completion rate, support tickets, and retention at 1 day.
deploy-bot: feature flag created: onboarding.flow_variant (default=bento).
Ben: action items: Kavi add localStorage + org flag, Iris run axe + NVDA pass, Nora write copy variants in Figma, I'll add event schema and dashboard tile.
Nora: thanks — scheduling a short usability session tomorrow 3pm to watch 5 new users. :eyes:
